# Architecture

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Style

Layered Laravel monolith: thin controllers/Livewire pages call single-purpose Action classes; Eloquent models; contracts for swappable video-AI and Mux clients; Filament admin as separate surface.

### Directory layout

```
app/
  Actions/          # use-case classes (Account, Admin, Ai, Billing, Menu, Panel, Support, Videos, RegisterRestaurantOwner)
  Console/Commands/ # app:create-super-admin, videos:prune
  Contracts/        # VideoGenerationProvider, AsyncVideoGenerationProvider, MuxClient
  Enums/            # TicketCategory, TicketStatus
  Exceptions/       # domain exceptions (e.g. InsufficientGenerationBalanceException)
  Filament/         # Filament 5 admin: Resources, Pages, Widgets
  Http/             # Controllers (Auth, Feed, Panel, Webhooks), Middleware
  Jobs/             # GenerateDishVideo, PollDishVideoGeneration, PurgeRestaurant, SmokeTestJob
  Listeners/        # StripeWebhookListener, EmbedBrandImages
  Models/           # ~35 Eloquent models incl. lookup tables (IsLookupTable)
  Notifications/    # PaymentFailed, PlanDowngraded, SupportTicketAnswered, UnreviewedVideosExpiring, VideoReadyForReview
  Policies/         # SupportTicketPolicy
  Services/         # Admin/BusinessMetrics, Ai (Gemini Veo, Null, resolver), Billing/CouponSync, Feed/FeedBuilder, Mux/MuxApiClient
  Support/          # Money, MuxUrls, QrCode, QrStyle, RestaurantQr, FeedSample, PanelNavigation, HomeRedirect
config/             # ai, feed, landing, services
database/           # 55 migrations, factories, seeders
resources/views/
  pages/{auth,panel}/  # Livewire single-file components (routes: 'pages::panel.x')
  feed/ marketing/ mail/ filament/ layouts/ components/ dev/ partials/
routes/             # web.php, console.php (no api.php)
tests/              # Feature (~70 Pest files), Unit, Fakes
compose.yaml        # Sail: app, queue, MySQL 8.4, Mailpit
```

### Layer responsibilities

| Layer | Owns | Does NOT own |
|---|---|---|
| Routes/Controllers | HTTP mapping, signature checks, validation (`DishViewController`) | Business rules |
| Livewire pages (`resources/views/pages`) | Panel/auth UI state | Persistence logic (delegated to Actions) |
| Actions | Transactions, balance/ledger, state changes | HTTP concerns |
| Services | Feed assembly, provider calls, metrics | Request handling |
| Contracts | Provider/Mux abstractions; `config/ai.php` maps slug → class | Implementations of vendors |
| Models | Relations, scopes, `canAddDish()`, `availableGenerations()` | Cross-aggregate flows |
| Jobs | Async generation/polling/purge | UI |
| Filament | Super-admin CRUD/ops | Owner panel |

Feed (`/r/{slug}`) is plain Blade + JS, no Livewire (README).

### External integration points

| System | Client/config | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Mux | `Contracts/MuxClient` ← `Services/Mux/MuxApiClient`, `config/services.php` `mux` | Webhook verified via `verifyWebhookSignature` |
| Stripe | Laravel Cashier, `Listeners/StripeWebhookListener` | Handles subscription.* and invoice.paid / payment_failed |
| Gemini Veo | `Services/Ai/GeminiVeoVideoGenerationProvider`, `config/services.php` `gemini` | Selected by `AI_VIDEO_PROVIDER` |
| S3 | `config/filesystems.php`, aws-sdk-php | Brand images/photos |

### Macro flow: Video generation

```
Panel (dish-video) --> RequestVideoGeneration --(balance check, tx)--> video_generations(fila)
                                  |
                                  v
                          GenerateDishVideo (queue)
                                  |
              sync provider <-----+-----> async provider.start()
                                                |
                                     PollDishVideoGeneration -> provider.poll()
                                  |
                                  v
                       Mux asset --> POST /webhooks/mux (video.asset.ready)
                                  |
                                  v
            video aguardando_aprovacao --> owner ApproveVideo --> DebitGenerationBalance
```

### Macro flow: Billing

```
Stripe --> Cashier webhook --> StripeWebhookListener
   invoice.paid -> ApplyPlan / RenewMonthlyBalance / GrantFirstSubscriptionBonus
   invoice.payment_failed -> PaymentFailed notification -> DowngradeToFreePlan
   subscription.deleted -> end reason recorded
```

Queue worker: `php artisan queue:work --tries=1 --sleep=3 --timeout=900` (`compose.yaml`); default connection `database` (`config/queue.php`). Scheduler: `videos:prune` daily 04:00 `onOneServer` (`routes/console.php`).
